name: Aumaan Orbital Foundry
backstory: Two sculpted combat frames trade mobility against distant firepower. Their arena partnership depends on balanced investment rather than either machine dominating the workshop budget.
strategy_personality: One of the strongest missing combat-machine pairs. Slender, sculpted Orbital Frames contrast with the bulkier Titans and BattleMechs already present. They are rivals in the source, not a canonical allied team. [Konami machine profiles](https://www.konami.com/games/zoe_hd/en_us/characters_anubis.html).

Subject: Authentic standard Jehuty orbital frame from Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner: elegant slender sculpted blue-grey and off-white humanoid mecha, orange/gold accents, turquoise Metatron lines, distinctive angular small head, long digitigrade legs with narrow pointed foot supports and iconic forward projecting cockpit structure at pelvis. Preserve exact orbital-frame anatomy and proportions, forearm blade retracted, full robot including all projections visible. No human pilot.

robots.equipment_interpretation: Jehuty fills the mobile skirmisher role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. robots.combat_rationale: Sprinter tuning supports the short equipment role; balanced stance and a 20% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Duo strategy tuning rules with the Sprinter Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Zone of the Enders  
**Strategy:** Duo · **Target roster:** 2 robots
**Catalogue key:** `aumaan-orbital-foundry`

**Proposed robots:** Jehuty; Anubis

**Direction:** One of the strongest missing combat-machine pairs. Slender, sculpted Orbital Frames contrast with the bulkier Titans and BattleMechs already present. They are rivals in the source, not a canonical allied team. [Konami machine profiles](https://www.konami.com/games/zoe_hd/en_us/characters_anubis.html).

**Production edition:** Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner — standard game bodies. Slot order follows the roster above.
purchasing_plan: Open with both robots. Alternate stage-1 equipment investment between slots 1 and 2; finish both final loadouts before refining. Visit both robots in each Hone pass, then each Augment pass, buying Workshop L1/L3 only as required. No Sharpen or Forge purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
